Ghana Health Service Issues Alert on Acute Respiratory Infections (ARI). The GHS has observed a rise in acute respiratory infections globally, particularly due to Human Metapneumovirus (hMPV).
Stay informed and stay safe!
#HealthAlert #Ghan
